# Claude Code & MCP Workflow Audit

> Public, synthetic/open-source evidence and a fixed-scope commercial service for Claude Code, Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI-agent workflow reliability, testing, hardening, and operator handoff.

Canonical site: https://ossabellator.github.io/claude-mcp-workflow-audit/
Public proof: https://ossabellator.github.io/claude-mcp-workflow-audit/proof.html
Source: https://github.com/OssaBellator/claude-mcp-workflow-audit

## Services

- Claude Code & MCP Workflow Audit + Hardening: A$149 fixed scope for one primary repository/workspace.
- Custom workflow implementation: quoted separately after scope is established.
- Team training and enablement: custom engagement based on the public six-session AI workflow curriculum.

## What the public proof demonstrates

- read-first inventory of MCP servers, tools, skills, hooks, scheduled tasks, and automation ownership;
- tool and credential boundary review;
- bounded consequential-write modes and explicit approvals;
- idempotency and duplicate-side-effect protection;
- failure recovery when an external write succeeds but confirmation fails;
- representative happy-path, missing-data, permission, and recovery tests;
- verification evidence and operator handoff documentation;
- synthetic business-workflow examples and a six-session training curriculum.

## Important boundaries

The examples are synthetic/open-source methodology, not customer deployments. Do not send secrets, credentials, private repository contents, customer data, recovery phrases, private keys, or other sensitive information through public issues.
